title: Mark OK is not offered on no-verdict fields, in Preview or when submitted
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. Fields/inspections covering: a field carrying no verdict (text, instructions, a photo); a read-only or submitted inspection; the builder Preview; a Single/Dual switch; and a field answered once rather than per position.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a field that carries no verdict (text, instructions, a photo) carries no action.
2. Confirm a read-only or submitted inspection offers none of it, and neither does the builder's Preview (read-only).
3. Confirm a Single/Dual switch counts as an edit and ends the report.
4. Confirm a field answered once rather than per position reports 'Marked OK' with no count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A field that carries no verdict (text, instructions, a photo) carries no action.
  • A read-only or submitted inspection offers none of it, and neither does the builder's Preview mode.
  • A Single/Dual switch counts as an edit and ends the report.
  • A field answered once rather than per position reports "Marked OK" with no count.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9883 (S18 — Mark a whole scope OK in one press); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S18; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-N1: “A field that carries no verdict — text, instructions, a photo — carries no action”
  • S18-N2: “A read-only or submitted inspection offers none of it. Neither does the builder's Preview mode, which is read-only by S12-R31 — an author sets a template up there, and marking work OK belongs to filling an inspection in”
  • S18-E1: “A Single/Dual switch counts as an edit and ends the report”
  • S18-E2: “A field answered once rather than per position reports "Marked OK" with no count”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
